result_text:
The stock list for a warehouse now leaves out products with zero quantity. Nuts taken out to zero no longer appear in WH-1's list, and a direct quantity lookup still returns 0.

The change is one condition in `listStockByWarehouse` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 1491). The query now has `AND s.quantity > 0`, the same filter the category, category-and-warehouse, and slow-moving overviews already use. `StockService.getWarehouseStock` delegates to it, so no service change was needed.

`StockOverviewTest` and `DemoScenarioTest` pass offline. I didn't add a test for the zero-quantity case from your example, so that scenario is covered only by reading the query. Nothing is committed.
